postBookingInfo:
Please contact the tour provider on +1 8002677581 or +39 3489236621 if you cant find your guide ten minutes before the tour starts.

If there are children in your tour group, please contact the tour provider at office@througheternity.com to indicate the children ages.

earlyArrival.label: Please arrive at least 15 minutes before the activity starts.

additionalInfo:
Please note that bags, backpacks, tripods and large umbrellas cannot be brought into the museum and will have to be left at the cloakroom. It's recommended to leave such items at your hotel.

Please inform the tour provider if there are people with reduced mobility. 

Please note that wheelchair users are required to leave their personal wheelchairs with the museum and use the one provided by the Galleria Borghese. 

This tour can accommodate pushchairs for children aged 0–2 years.

If there are children in your tour group, please indicate the ages of all children travelling with you in an email.

Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
description:
On this private tour, you'll be able to surround yourself in beauty and art inside the beautiful Galleria Borghese.

Led by an expert guide, you'll get the chance to admire a large collection of Renaissance and Baroque masterpieces by Bernini, Caravaggio, Canova and other renowned artists. As you move around the gorgeous rooms, you will be able to appreciate the frescoes and decorations while hearing more about the Borghese family and the history of the gallery. 

You'll then continue your tour strolling the landscaped gardens outside. Here you'll be able to admire the beautiful landscape and enjoy unparalleled views of Rome from the top of the viewpoint – Pincio Terrace.

meeting.instructions: Meet your guide at the entrance of the Borghese Gallery in the Villa Borghese park.
